method: Bilinear resampling of real elevation only; nearest/mode categorical cover. No synthetic relief noise, no height exaggeration. Same canonical grid sampled at each LOD.
omissions: Small source islands with projected area below10squarekm may be subpixel at canonical/overview; vector geometry is retained and specific omission inventory measured. Protected Sicily/Sardinia/Corsica/Crete/Cyprus never omitted. Native15s detail preserves input heights, no invented microdetail.

landcover.10: trees represented with stable seeded illustrative individuals; no measured tree positions
landcover.40: neutral homogeneous natural-looking surface; no fields or presumed historical vegetation
